title: chemoqbit: active-space quantum circuits for 5-fluorouracil tautomerism and thymidylate synthase hydride transfer, with FPGA fixed-point emulation
description: Code, results and tests for end-to-end studies of chemical reactions on qubits. (1) The lactam-lactim proton shift of 5-fluorouracil and formamide: PySCF active spaces, UCCSD and ADAPT-VQE with adjoint gradients, a 32-bit instruction set and bit-accurate 18-bit fixed-point emulation for the qsim-pynq FPGA simulator (PYNQ-Z2), composite CCSD(T) corrections and Eckart tunnelling. (2) New in 1.1.0: hydride transfer in thymidylate synthase, using a 96-atom active-site cluster built from PDB 1TLS. The pipeline runs a GFN2-xTB reaction scan with consistency guards and a backward pass, a frozen-atom-aware P-RFO saddle search, finite-difference Hessians, and H/D/T kinetic isotope effects with Wigner and Eckart tunnelling. It adds B3LYP-D3(BJ)/PCM single points, an electrostatically embedded active space with UCCSD- and ADAPT-VQE, ONIOM(CCSD(T):B3LYP) with a DF-MP2 basis-set correction, a functional-sensitivity check, and a PDF report generator. Includes a FastAPI module for an oncology research platform. Educational; not for clinical use.
